findings: The preserved source is genuinely underspecified about the searched container, adjacency, cell reuse and the identity of one occurrence; the candidate explicitly preserves this uncertainty.
The rectangular four-neighbor distinct-simple-path model is labeled as a reference contract rather than claimed as recovered source semantics.

The recursive implementation has the required counting semantics: successful paths contribute one and sibling branches are accumulated; per-path used state is restored so different paths may reuse cells independently.
The answer distinguishes existence from counting and explains why global visited or success short-circuiting would be incorrect for the declared path-count contract.
A structurally separate bottom-up sparse DP over (mask,end-position) states passes fixed boundaries and 12,000 seeded random cases; malformed ragged grids are rejected consistently.
